purpose: Register official source families for discovering, verifying and connecting South African institutions and opportunities across the six Kingsmen pathways.

coverage_model.registry_completeness_target: Every currently registered or established post-school institution in the latest official DHET masterlist, reconciled by source record and snapshot.
coverage_model.opportunity_completeness_target: Candidate-facing listings lawfully discoverable from authoritative public sources or authorized partner feeds, each with item-level evidence.
coverage_model.application_connectivity_target: One Kingsmen candidate profile/workbench with controlled portal handoff; direct API submission and status synchronization only when the institution authorizes it.
coverage_model.not_a_claim: A source URL does not prove that a particular institution, programme, deadline, accreditation, eligibility or outcome is current.

current_live_baseline.interpretation: Official-source anchors and a small legacy route catalogue exist, but the canonical verified opportunity pipeline has no live provider/programme/observation/deadline/match rows. Institutional coverage must not be advertised as complete.

publication_invariants: An institution-directory row never implies an open programme or vacancy.
Only authoritative exact-source evidence can establish a candidate-facing listing.
Every published opportunity must have evidence references, observed_at, last_checked_at and stale_after; stale rows fail closed.
Unknown eligibility remains unknown and is not converted to a match guarantee.
A candidate-reported submission is distinct from provider-confirmed receipt or outcome.
Candidate credentials are never shared with institutions or stored by source adapters.
Do not automate third-party login, CAPTCHA, payment or submission unless an institution explicitly authorizes a supported integration and security review passes.
API availability is UNVERIFIED until an official specification, written authorization and tested sandbox or approved test environment exist.

sources.name: DHET Masterlist of Registered and Established PSET Institutions
sources.authority: Department of Higher Education and Training
evidence_required: source record or downloaded register version
source-file hash or stable official page reference
sources.notes: Primary national roster seed. Preserve DHET entity type/status and source snapshot; never invent a record to fill gaps.

sources.name: DHET university directory
sources.authority: Department of Higher Education and Training
evidence_required: entity name/URL reconciliation against current masterlist
sources.notes: Cross-check only. The current masterlist remains canonical if names or institution types differ.

sources.name: DHET TVET Colleges directory and occupational-programme resources
sources.authority: Department of Higher Education and Training
sources.notes: A national directory establishes college identity, not an active intake. Check programmes and deadlines at the college or specified official source.

sources.name: DHET Sector Education and Training Authorities directory
sources.authority: Department of Higher Education and Training
sources.notes: Discovery roster only. Individual SETA programme availability must be separately verified.

sources.name: DHET registered private college and private higher education institution registers
sources.authority: Department of Higher Education and Training
sources.notes: Do not mark providers registered or accredited from their marketing site alone.

sources.name: Council on Higher Education
sources.authority: Council on Higher Education
sources.notes: Quality/registration cross-check; not evidence of a live application window.

sources.name: QCTO skills development provider database
sources.authority: Quality Council for Trades and Occupations
evidence_required: validity or decision date where available
sources.notes: Accreditation must be checked for the relevant scope; provider registration does not prove every advertised programme is accredited.

sources.name: QCTO registered occupational qualifications and part-qualifications
sources.authority: Quality Council for Trades and Occupations
sources.notes: Qualification registration and a current learner intake are separate facts.

sources.name: SAQA qualifications and unit standards register
sources.authority: South African Qualifications Authority
sources.notes: Validate qualification claims; do not infer enrolment availability or candidate eligibility.

sources.name: Central Applications Office
sources.authority: Central Applications Office
evidence_required: authorized sandbox or signed integration agreement before API submission
sources.notes: Keep one Kingsmen parent application with CAO choices as children. CAO terms give institutions final admission-selection responsibility; never claim Kingsmen submitted or received an offer without evidence.

sources.name: National Student Financial Aid Scheme
sources.authority: NSFAS
evidence_required: candidate reference or provider-confirmed status only after authorized handoff
sources.notes: Funding is separate from admission. Never present a public funding window as institution acceptance or guaranteed eligibility.

sources.name: South African Government public-service vacancy circular
sources.authority: South African Government
evidence_required: closing date and timezone if stated
sources.notes: Check each circular/advert individually. Historical circulars are not active vacancy evidence.

sources.name: Department of Employment and Labour vacancies
sources.authority: Department of Employment and Labour
sources.notes: The directory itself is not a live application receipt.

sources.name: National Pathway Management Network partner directory
sources.authority: The Presidency / Department of Employment and Labour
evidence_required: written access approval before protected-data ingestion
sources.notes: NPMN is a partner network; it does not imply that all partner systems expose a public API.

sources.name: Employment Services of South Africa
sources.authority: Department of Employment and Labour
evidence_required: written permission and least-privilege credential scope
sources.notes: Do not scrape authenticated screens or claim a candidate registered through a Kingsmen profile.

sources.name: SA Youth
sources.authority: Harambee Youth Employment Accelerator / NPMN
sources.notes: Public partner status does not grant Kingsmen access to protected records.

sources.name: Youth Employment Service
sources.authority: YES4Youth
evidence_required: written permission for feeds/APIs where applicable
sources.notes: Reliable machine-readable listing and outcome sync may require a partner agreement.

sources.name: Tshepo 1 Million
sources.authority: Gauteng Provincial Government
sources.notes: Treat as a partner platform until a public feed or approved interface is verified.

sources.name: Khetha / National Career Advice Portal
sources.authority: DHET Career Development Services
evidence_required: current advice source URL and retrieval timestamp
sources.notes: Guidance only; not proof of an open opportunity or eligibility.

sources.name: Institution-owned admissions, programme, residence and student-support portals
sources.authority: The specific institution in the current DHET register
evidence_required: written authorization before private API/transaction integration
sources.notes: Institutions use different portals, calendars, document rules and workflows. Residence portals are institution-specific.

sources.name: Individual SETA official programme and employer-provider portals
sources.authority: The specific SETA in the current DHET directory
sources.notes: SETA presence does not prove a programme, funded learner slot or intake is open.

sources.name: Institution residences and independently verified accommodation providers
sources.authority: The specific institution or verified accommodation operator
sources.notes: Accommodation is cross-pathway support, not a seventh opportunity pathway. No live bed availability or price should be invented.

rollout_targets.phase_0: 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-07: reconcile RC/release evidence; freeze connector contract and source register; keep stale data unpublished.
rollout_targets.phase_1: Target by 2026-11-14, conditional on release gates and reliable DHET register access: import the complete official PSET masterlist and publish reconciliation counts.
rollout_targets.phase_2: Target by 2026-11-21: first verified listing cohort spanning higher education/CAO, TVET, skills providers/SETA and public employment; each listing has source, freshness, application mode and evidence checks.
rollout_targets.phase_3: 2026-11 to 2026-12: expand per-institution adapters, residence/accommodation discovery, monitoring, expiry and correction workflows; prioritize by coverage and candidate value.
rollout_targets.phase_4: Partner-dependent: direct submission/status APIs only after each institution authorizes endpoints, supplies a test environment, and approves data sharing and acceptance tests.
rollout_targets.date_semantics: These are internal target windows, not achieved milestones or guaranteed dates. Phase 1 depends on retrieving a current official register; Phase 2 depends on live evidence and review; Phase 4 depends on independent institutions.
